quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Denko semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (10-29-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025): revenue JPY 513,569 million (down 1.6%), operating profit JPY 94,504 million (down 13.5%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 68,926 million (down 13.8%); management states demand for its products rose as some IT device and high-end smartphone production was pulled forward during the grace period before additional US tariffs, and nucleic acid contract manufacturing improved as large-disease projects moved to the commercial stage; the yen was 4.7% stronger at JPY 146.4 per US dollar, reducing operating profit by JPY 10.5 billion; H1 R&D expenses JPY 23,286 million
quarterly_data.figure: revenue JPY 513,569 million (-1.6%); operating profit JPY 94,504 million (-13.5%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Denko semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (10-29-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Industrial Tape segment H1 FY2026 revenue JPY 179,189 million (up 1.4%), operating profit JPY 23,683 million (down 6.3%): demand rose for high-end smartphone assembly materials as more models adopted electric debonding tape for battery fixing and for process materials used in producing semiconductor memory, ceramic capacitors and the like; automotive materials fell on lower vehicle production by Japanese automakers in China
quarterly_data.figure: Industrial Tape revenue JPY 179,189 million (+1.4%); operating profit JPY 23,683 million (-6.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Denko semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (10-29-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Optronics segment H1 FY2026 revenue JPY 269,859 million (down 5.7%), operating profit JPY 77,086 million (down 19.8%): optical film demand rose on pulled-forward high-end laptop and tablet production, but revenue fell on the strategic withdrawal from LCD smartphone optical films and process protection film price cuts; circuit materials revenue fell - high-precision board demand rose on pulled-forward high-end smartphone production, while CIS (Circuit Integrated Suspension) demand declined against the prior-year half, when HDD market demand had recovered rapidly
quarterly_data.figure: Optronics revenue JPY 269,859 million (-5.7%); operating profit JPY 77,086 million (-19.8%)

quarterly_data.figure: Human Life revenue JPY 69,619 million (+6.5%); operating loss JPY 1,598 million
